name: Investment sell and edit, email feedback
notes: Sell shares and see profit or loss (average cost method), edit or delete share purchases and sales, edit company names. Bug and feedback reports now open your email app with a required subject. Updated contact links. The helper knows about all of this. Signed with the same key as 2.4.0 to 2.4.4, so it installs over those. It cannot be installed over 2.3.0 or earlier: save a backup file first, uninstall the old app, install this one, then restore.
